mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, category_id AS categoryId, sale_type AS saleType, brand, product_name AS productName, product_name_jp AS productNameJp, price_jpy AS priceJpy, original_price_jpy AS originalPriceJpy, stock, sales_count AS salesCount, thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, status FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY product_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( category_id, sale_type, brand, product_name, product_name_jp, price_jpy, original_price_jpy, stock, sales_count, thumbnail_url, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{saleType}, #{brand}, #{productName}, #{productNameJp}, #{priceJpy}, #{originalPriceJpy}, #{stock}, 0, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO GROUP_BUY ( product_id, creator_id, title, description, target_quantity, current_quantity, start_date, end_date, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{creatorId}, #{request.groupBuyTitle}, #{request.groupBuyDescription}, #{request.targetQuantity}, 0, #{request.startDate}, #{request.endDate}, 'RECRUITING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET category_id = #{request.categoryId}, price_jpy = #{request.priceJpy}, original_price_jpy = #{request.originalPriceJpy}, stock = #{request.stock}, status = #{request.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_id = #{productId}
